title: SR 10 over I-65 | retained bridge with proposed 2026 approaches
source_note: INDOT R-43918 proposed 2026 approaches over the retained 1998 B-23753 widened steel bridge, with the 2019 B-41210 nominal polymeric overlay retained. 2026 general/detail sheets use suffix C while the title uses D; both are preserved. Construction completion is not established. Drawing download is a local review binder; original source files and page offsets are recorded in source_index.json.
assumptions: Exterior visualization reconstruction, not an as-built survey, load rating or validated FEM mesh.
No internal reinforcement, prestressing strands, embedded studs, weld beads or fabrication holes. Material colors are visualization choices.
Source pages mix historical removals and proposed work. Only the explicitly named design state is modeled; the separately stored later references do not alter that state.
Buried foundations are hidden by default. Unknown driven pile lengths, terrain and approach-road terminal systems are omitted.
Bearing contact checks verify constructed geometric attachment only; they do not establish surveyed bearing elevations or fabrication tolerances.
Metric structural dimensions and 2026 imperial general-plan dimensions are explicitly distinguished; small rounding differences remain.
1998 grade curve (65 m) governs the structural display; 2019 says 215 ft and 2026 says 213.25 ft. Current surveyed grades and bearing seats are not available.
Nominal W sections are visualization profiles, not verified section properties. No FEM analysis was generated for this bridge.

detail_coverage.detail: Nine nonuniformly spaced beam lines, all four spans, widened slab and a separate nominal retained overlay.

Diaphragm rows per sheets 13/15: MC460x63.5 in spans A/D and the exterior bays, retained W460x68 and one C380x74 bay in spans B/C lapping the retained W460x68 stubs; connection angles omitted. Field splices per sheet 14 (Type I / Type II plates, bars, fillers, web and flange bolts) and the retained 1964 Pier 3 splices (plates, bars, web and flange rivets). Haunches per the sheet 17 typical detail. 27 pier bearings: Pier 3 fixed shoes and Pier 2/4 Type I elastomeric bearings with the sheet 16 shims. Beams fitted to the drawing support elevations with catalog depths. Both end bents are integral, with no invented end bearings.

Piers 2/4 reconstructed side-wall stems with the sheet 11 cap top (El. 215.972 / 216.016); Pier 3 retained hammerhead (El. 215.835 / 215.879), added outer columns, low collision walls and widened footings per sheet 12. Pier 2/4 footing offsets remain approximate.
Existing barrier envelopes, both proposed 2026 12 in approach slabs, four transition envelopes and eight drain outlets. Drain piping and slab penetrations remain incomplete.
Precise rolled sections, camber and field seats, buried pile tips, full slopewalls and drainage collectors, bolts/gussets and terminal hardware. Interchange roadways are outside this GLB.

The length and taper of the thickened end are settled only by those standard drawings (the edition cited by R-43918) or an as-built survey of the bent ends.

known_deviations.deviation: The sheet 17 table gives one Dimension "A" per beam line (soffit to the underside of the top flange, 50/50/62/73/95 mm for drawing lines 1-5, symmetric) and no stations. The model agrees with it at Piers 2, 3 and 4 (-0.5 to +2.2 mm). At the bents the written pile cutoffs + 19 mm plate give about 50-53 mm on every line, so the span A/D haunches of drawing lines 3-7 taper from the table value at the piers to that at the bents (table minus model at the bents: line 1 -2 mm, line 2 -3 mm, line 3 +10 mm, line 4 +21 mm, line 5 +43 mm).
known_deviations.reason: The table carries no stations and conflicts with the written pile cutoff elevations at the bents (sheet 9), which agree with the blocking diagram; the model follows the elevations. Settled by a haunch or screed table by station, or a top-of-steel survey at the end bents.

known_deviations.deviation: The 4 bottom-flange rivets 3 in off the centre line of each retained Pier 3 splice (28 in all) are omitted: they lie inside the 230 x 310 mm top shoe and shim footprint. All other web and flange rivets and the inner bars are modelled.
known_deviations.reason: S9 does not show how those rivet heads are treated under the shoe (countersunk, or cleared by the shim), next to the separate 1 in holes for the 1964 shoe studs, and the 1998 shoe (sheet 14) does not say either. Settled by the 1964 shop drawings or a field inspection of the Pier 3 bearings.

known_deviations.deviation: The C380x74 replacement diaphragms are placed on the +X (east) side of the W460x68 stub webs, back to back with them.
known_deviations.reason: Detail "B" and Section C-C show the channel on one side of the stub web but carry no north arrow or station direction. Settled by the 1998 shop drawings or a field inspection.
